head_commit.message:
Include buffered turns when editing prompts (#37622)

## Why

Prompt editing looks up the selected user message in the thread's turns, but
new live turns may still exist only in the replay buffer.

## What changed

Reconstruct buffered turns from turn and item notifications before locating
the prompt to edit. Preserve completion metadata and avoid duplicating turns
or items already present in the snapshot.

## Testing

Extend the prompt-edit fork test to cover a selected turn supplied through the
replay buffer and verify that the source thread remains unchanged.

Prompt editing looks up the selected user message in the thread's turns, but

the prompt to edit. Preserve completion metadata and avoid duplicating turns
or items already present in the snapshot.

## Testing

Extend the prompt-edit fork test to cover a selected turn supplied through the
replay buffer and verify that the source thread remains unchanged.
